_meta.title: Infrastructure domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/infrastructure.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing infrastructure.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/infrastructure.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME SIGNATURE AS ENERGY/FINANCE, but LESS SEVERE on one axis and MORE on another. Infrastructure shows the identical feedforward-only signature: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges (recurrentFraction 0) despite carrying directed control rings. UNLIKE Finance, the graph is NOT pre-fractured — baseComponents = 1 (Finance had 2 because of a disconnected {M1, SMA} dyad; here SMA->M1 plus M1's four other edges keep the motor cluster attached). BUT Infrastructure has MORE single points of failure: 10 articulation nodes (Finance had 9, Energy fewer), because the shared neuro backbone hangs many dedicated sensory/limbic leaves (S1, LGN, MGN, PI, HPA, rACC, PAG, VP, VTA, SMA) off single hubs.

recurrenceAudit.note: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges — the same feedforward-only signature the neuro reference calls the broken version. The graph does carry directed cycles (the business-layer ring CC->THAL->HYPO->LANG->dlPFC->FORN->CC via CONTROLS/DEPENDS_ON edges), but for no edge A->B does B->A exist, so recurrentFraction is exactly 0. The module's verdict = 'has recurrent/lateral structure' only because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.371) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is fully absent. unknownGroupEdges (26) are edges touching nodes not in the activation set (sensory/limbic backbone nodes V1, A1, S1, LGN, MGN, BLA, PVN, GP, mPFC, etc.).

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: ONE connected component at baseline (better than Finance's 2). The {M1, SMA} motor cluster that was a disconnected dyad in Finance is attached here via UNC->M1, M1->dACC, FPN->M1, M1->ENS (SMA->M1 is the only internal dyad edge, but M1 itself is richly connected).

mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: sole attachment of leaf S1 (THAL->S1 only) and of the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} (A1's only non-leaf link is THAL->A1; MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge). Removing THAL splits off S1 and {A1, MGN} -> 3 components. NOTE: unlike Finance, CBLM does NOT hang off THAL (CBLM also has CC->CBLM and CBLM->FEF), so THAL does not isolate CBLM here.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.M1: sole attachment of leaf SMA (SMA->M1 is SMA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.BLA: sole attachment of leaf rACC (rACC->BLA is rACC's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG is PAG's only edge) AND sole main-body bridge of the mesolimbic tail {OFC, NAcc, VTA, VP} (OFC->vmPFC is OFC's only link toward the main body). Removing vmPFC splits off PAG and the whole mesolimbic tail -> 3 components.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaf LGN (LGN->V1 is LGN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of leaf PI (PI->AI is PI's only edge). NOTE: NTS is NOT a leaf of AI here (NTS also has FEF->NTS and NTS->STRI), so AI isolates only PI.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: sole attachment of BOTH leaves VTA (VTA->NAcc) and VP (NAcc->VP) — the mesolimbic reward dyad. Removing NAcc splits off {VTA, VP} -> 3 components.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.OFC: sole main-body bridge of {NAcc, VTA, VP}: NAcc's only non-leaf link is NAcc->OFC. Removing OFC isolates the {NAcc, VTA, VP} cluster -> 2 components.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the thalamo-cortico-thalamic somatosensory loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, sensory relay). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback S1->VPL is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain (feedback outnumbers feedforward), functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', THAL = motif M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the conflict/error signal feeds back to the executive to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; they are adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds forward-and-back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the thalamo-amygdalar loop that the business-layer edge CeA->THAL (DEPENDS_ON) opens: the relay hub feeds the amygdalar alarm and the alarm gates the relay.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge CeA->THAL (DEPENDS_ON). The thalamo-amygdala 'low road' (sensory thalamus -> amygdala, LeDoux) is a canonical direct projection. canonical-nodes THAL = M4 routing hub, CeA = M7 'phasic fear output'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: S1 reaches the graph only via THAL->S1, so removing THAL isolates it. A somatosensory->motor edge gives S1 a second anchor (M1 is a main-body node here, unlike Finance where M1 was disconnected); removing THAL then leaves S1 attached via M1. Together with A1->AI below this FULLY de-articulates THAL.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. Dense reciprocal somatomotor (S1<->M1) connectivity is textbook; sensory feedback to motor cortex guides ongoing movement. (Finance recorded S1->M1 as a groundable-but-unused edge because M1 was off the main body and CBLM still hung off THAL; here M1 is on the main body and CBLM does not hang off THAL, so the edge is both groundable and load-bearing.)

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Gives the auditory cortex a cortical anchor off the THAL hub, reattaching the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} to the main body when THAL is removed.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; auditory cortex projects to the insular cortex (auditory-to-insula projection is documented; the insula integrates auditory salience).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PI reaches the graph only via PI->AI, so removing AI isolates it. A posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor; removing AI then leaves PI attached via dACC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as class 'composite' / remapTo 'view' ('not an edge endpoint'); the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view (HYPO->PIT->ADR loop) rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: rACC reaches the graph only via rACC->BLA, so removing BLA isolates it. A medial-PFC affective-regulation edge gives rACC a second anchor; removing BLA then leaves rACC attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation', vmPFC = M1 top-down brake. rACC and vmPFC are adjacent ventromedial affective-regulation regions with reciprocal connectivity (the emotion-regulation medial-PFC cluster).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output'; PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: VP reaches the graph only via NAcc->VP, so removing NAcc isolates it. The reward-loop closure edge VP->VTA gives VP a second anchor (via VTA); paired with VTA->dlPFC below, the {VTA, VP} dyad survives NAcc removal. Doubles as recurrence: closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'. One edge serves both recurrence and redundancy.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Anchors the entire mesolimbic tail {VTA, VP, NAcc} to a main-body node OTHER than NAcc/OFC/vmPFC. With this edge, removing NAcc leaves {VTA, VP} attached via VTA->dlPFC, and removing OFC leaves {NAcc, VTA, VP} attached the same way — de-articulating BOTH NAcc and OFC in one move (verified: adding this drops both from the articulation set).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. The VTA mesocortical dopamine projection to prefrontal cortex (including dorsolateral PFC) is canonical (the mesocortical arm of the dopamine system, distinct from the mesolimbic VTA->NAcc arm already in-graph).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: SMA reaches the graph only via SMA->M1, so removing M1 isolates it. A corticostriatal edge gives SMA a second anchor; removing M1 then leaves SMA attached via STRI (a main-body hub).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'; SMA is a principal cortical source of the motor corticostriatal projection to putamen/striatum (canonical). NOTE: canonical-nodes marks STRI as class 'composite' / remapTo 'view' (CAUD+PUT+NAcc); STRI is nonetheless used as an in-graph edge endpoint (STRI->HYPO, STRI->GP, NTS->STRI), so the edge is consistent with current wiring, though the cleaner long-run fix is to target PUT specifically.

projectedImpact.method: The 17 proposed edges (8 feedback + 9 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of infrastructure.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. infrastructure.json itself was NOT modified.

recurrentFraction.note: crosses the 0.2 tree-vs-mesh threshold; the 8 reciprocal pairs are exactly the 8 proposedFeedbackEdges (each is the reverse of a pre-existing edge).

baseComponents.note: already 1; the redundant edges do not fragment it and give the leaves/islands second anchors.

articulationNodes.reason: Both residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory relay leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: V1 still cuts off LGN; A1 still cuts off MGN. This is the same honest floor Energy and Finance bottomed out at (all three remained articulate at V1/A1 for the identical LGN/MGN reason). NOTE: the mesolimbic tail (NAcc, OFC) and the sensory/limbic leaves (S1, PI, HPA, rACC, PAG, VP, SMA) and the THAL hub ALL clear the articulation set, so Infrastructure ends at the same 2-node floor as Finance despite starting with one more articulation node.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the infrastructure graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1, and V1 stays a residual articulation point for it.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1.

Hippocampal output to lateral PFC is not a monosynaptic projection; direct hippocampal-PFC fibers target mPFC/vmPFC, not dlPFC, and the mPFC relay is not on an infrastructure-graph edge path. Cannot ground a direct HIPP->dlPFC edge (same omission as Finance).

The thalamus does not project to the cerebellum; cerebellar cortical input arrives polysynaptically via the pontine nuclei (no direct thalamus->CBLM fiber). CBLM->THAL (excit) stays one-way. (In Infrastructure CBLM is not a THAL leaf anyway, so this omission costs no de-articulation.)

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: AI->OFC (insula->orbitofrontal, gustatory/interoceptive into valuation) is a groundable edge that Finance used as its dACC-bypass; it was TESTED here and found REDUNDANT — VTA->dlPFC alone already de-articulates the mesolimbic tail, so AI->OFC was dropped to keep every proposed edge load-bearing rather than gold-plating. It is recorded here as a groundable future edge, not an omission for lack of grounding.
